title: FARDC Launches Airstrikes on AFC/M23 Positions at Malemo and Luola
detail: In the afternoon of Tuesday, Sept 8, the FARDC conducted aerial bombardments against AFC/M23 positions at Malemo, in Masisi's Bashali Mokoto grouping, and at Luola, in Walikale's Kisimba grouping, after local sources reported an AFC/M23 troop buildup along the strategic Masisi-Walikale corridor. Reinforcement movements were also observed at Ihula (Balindu locality, Kisimba grouping), and analysts said the rebels appeared to be positioning for a further push toward Pinga via the Malemo-Mindjendje and Luola-Mpety axes. No reliable casualty or damage assessment of the strikes was available, and AFC/M23 maintained its positions afterward. Civilians continued moving toward safer zones amid a particularly tense situation.

title: Wazalendo Dislodge AFC/M23 From Rutoboko and Kibahemula in Masisi
detail: Wazalendo fighters dislodged AFC/M23 rebels from Rutoboko and recovered control of Kibahemula, both villages in Masisi's Nyamaboko I grouping, on Sept 8 — a localized counteroffensive success even as AFC/M23 retained the nearby Humura commercial center it captured Sept 6-7. Nyamaboko I sits on a critical axis linking Masisi and Walikale territories. No precise human or material toll has been established for the clashes, and relative calm was reported in the area by Sept 9, though troop movements continued to unsettle the civilian population.
